channel.title: What's New with AWS
channel.description: Announcements of new AWS services and features.

item.title: Amazon EC2 R9i instances are now generally available in additional regions
item.description:
Starting today, Amazon EC2 R9i instances are available in the Europe (Stockholm) and Asia Pacific (Seoul) Regions.

R9i instances deliver up to 20% better price performance than R8i. Learn more

item.title: AWS Lambda adds support for Node.js 26 & Python 3.15
item.description: AWS Lambda now supports creating functions with the Node.js 26 and Python 3.15 runtimes.

item.title: Amazon S3 Tables adds cross-region replication
item.description:
You can now replicate S3 Tables across AWS Regions and accounts.

  • Replicas stay in sync within minutes
  • Works with Apache Iceberg catalogs

item.title: Amazon CloudWatch now supports cross-account log anomaly detection
item.description: CloudWatch Logs anomaly detection can now run across the accounts of an AWS Organization.

item.title: AWS Backup adds support for Amazon FSx for OpenZFS
item.description: AWS Backup now protects Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file systems.

item.title: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL supports minor versions 17.7 and 16.11
item.description: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL now supports the latest minor versions.

item.title: Amazon Bedrock adds batch inference for more models
item.description: Batch inference is now available for additional models in Amazon Bedrock.
